strongest_objection: The map's closing item, the endpoint its axis is written to reach and the target of one of its two passages, is not a member of its own type. Coordination spent says in its first clause that 'the reversal has no bill because it has no payer' and in its last that the reversal is 'unavailable to all of them', and the map's own fifth boundary rules that 'a way back that is gone entirely belongs to the neighbor map on option expiry; every item here has a way back that can still be bought'. A coordination lost without anyone declining it is, word for word, the territory the fleet brief assigns to option-expiries. The item's mechanism is also contradicted by its headline case: it claims the move 'consumed a willingness to change together', but Sweden switched in 1967 against a 1955 referendum that voted overwhelmingly to keep left, so no willingness was there to consume and the Riksdag's date did the work, which is exactly the date-setter the item's own Okinawa correction says the return needs. What survives, and is worth keeping as the walk's last stop, is a real bill the move's account did not show: the move's focal date was supplied from outside for free and the return's must be manufactured, so the bill is a date-setter's existence and is presented to no one until someone volunteers to be that. I repaired the item to say that and relabeled the Second key edge to match. The second thing wrong is internal: Successor pays the write-down concludes that rotating offices 'will make moves and not unmake them, and the reversals wait for a holder with nothing to lose', while its own edge to Retraction read by the room says the successor 'takes the write-down without the reputation bill', and the observed corporate pattern is the incoming chief executive's first-year big bath, reversals clustering at the handover precisely because the room charges them to the predecessor; the item now names the housecleaning window as the condition and keeps the waiting claim for the cases, a tax restored or a withdrawal signed, where the room grants none. Beneath these, two illustrative cases sit outside the map's fences (a repudiated contract's election is the move's own paper; the lost Roth recharacterization is a way back removed, not a taxed unwind), and the loop's first edge fires only if the mover knows the way back has rotted, which the item says is invisible until the attempt, so the label now routes through the attempt. No item restates clean-exits or forms-of-return: every citation of those maps names a mechanism of leaving or returning and takes only the bill for coming back, and Writes in the interval against Hard reset, Chair already given away against Queue at the door, and Truce against Agamemnon's bath each add the bill, the payer, and the discovery the neighbor does not carry.

items.item: Second undo is with prejudice: a rule meters reversals so that the first is free and the second costs the thing being reversed, as a plaintiff may dismiss a federal suit once by notice and a second voluntary dismissal of the same claim is an adjudication on the merits, as a retirement account may be rolled over once in twelve months and a second rollover is a taxed distribution, as the employer that takes a leaver back once reads the second leaving as the answer; the bill is borne by the mover; it is discovered at the second attempt, by the party who thought the first had been free, and it was readable in the rule before the first move by anyone who looked; the reversal cannot restore the count, since the count is what the reversal spent; not forms-of-return's Open-box refund, where the interval is priced onto the particular, since here nothing is marked and what is spent is a number kept by the rule.
items.why: A real metering rule in both legal cases (the two-dismissal rule of federal procedure; the one-rollover-per-twelve-months rule since 2015), and the mechanism is sharper than it first reads: the first undo looks free and spends the count, which is exactly a cost the move's own account does not show. The rollover rule counts moves of a kind rather than reversals as such, which the item tolerates because the reversal is a move of that kind. Not a restatement of forms-of-return's Open-box refund, as the item says.

items.item: Second key for the way back: the move needed one assent and the reversal needs a second that the move did not, as a raise given by a manager's signature is taken back, in much of Europe, only with the employee's consent or through a procedure the law sets, as a grant approved by a board is clawed back, absent a clawback clause written before the grant, only with the grantee's signature, as a wire sent on the payer's instruction alone is recalled only if the receiving bank and its customer agree, as a buyer who repudiates a signed contract hands the seller the election between holding the buyer to it and taking damages, and, in the unwritten form, as a perk given to a team is taken back only past the party the giving created, which holds the key by being able to leave; the bill is the second key's price and its delay, borne by the mover; it is discovered at the attempt, when the mover reaches for a hand that is not its own, and the written key was readable before the move; the reversal cannot restore the one-hand state in which the move was made, since the second hand, once used, has learned that it holds a key; where the rule runs the other way, as a treaty entered by two-thirds of a senate and left, in practice, by one signature, this item has no bill and the move is the costly leg; not term-sheet-powers' Veto priced by the clock, a class vote written at signing over named states, since here the key did not exist until the move made it.
items.why: One mechanism, an assent the reversal needs that the move did not, carried across written and unwritten holders; the merge the ledger records is sound. But the repudiated-contract case is outside the map's own first fence: a signed contract's bindingness, and the seller's election against a repudiating buyer, is the move's own paper, 'known to both hands before the move', the same ground on which the termination fee was refused. Dropped that case and named the exclusion so the next reader does not put it back.
items.repair: Second key for the way back: the move needed one assent and the reversal needs a second that the move did not, as a raise given by a manager's signature is taken back, in much of Europe, only with the employee's consent or through a procedure the law sets, as a grant approved by a board is clawed back, absent a clawback clause written before the grant, only with the grantee's signature, as a wire sent on the payer's instruction alone is recalled only if the receiving bank and its customer agree, and, in the unwritten form, as a perk given to a team is taken back only past the party the giving created, which holds the key by being able to leave; the bill is the second key's price and its delay, borne by the mover; it is discovered at the attempt, when the mover reaches for a hand that is not its own, and the written key was readable before the move; the reversal cannot restore the one-hand state in which the move was made, since the second hand, once used, has learned that it holds a key; where the rule runs the other way, as a treaty entered by two-thirds of a senate and left, in practice, by one signature, this item has no bill and the move is the costly leg; not term-sheet-powers' Veto priced by the clock, a class vote written at signing over named states, since here the key did not exist until the move made it, and not a signed contract's ordinary bindingness, the seller's election against a buyer who repudiates, since that is the move's own paper and outside this map.

items.item: Set like plaster: the moved thing hardens by a process of its own that ran while the move stood, so the reversal's bill is a demolition sized by elapsed time, as a blast furnace banked hot is brought back in days and one let go cold cracks its lining and is relined at the cost of a rebuild, as a vasectomy reversed within a few years usually restores fertility and reversed after fifteen does so less often, since the body has been making antibodies against what it no longer uses, as a temporary reporting line that stood a year is the organization and is reversed as a reorganization; the bill is borne by the mover; it is discovered when the quote for the way back comes in, and the quote's size is the date, so a mover who reads it learns how long the move stood; the reversal cannot restore the wet state, only produce a second setting; not lead-time-floors' Gestation, a replacement that must grow, since here it is the move that grew and the growing is the bill.
items.why: Mechanism holds and the furnace and reporting-line cases are sound. The vasectomy clause asserts a single cause, antibodies, where the larger documented cause of falling reversal success with time is secondary obstruction of the unused tract; a mechanism clause should not name the minor cause as the mechanism. One-clause repair, nothing else touched.
items.repair: Set like plaster: the moved thing hardens by a process of its own that ran while the move stood, so the reversal's bill is a demolition sized by elapsed time, as a blast furnace banked hot is brought back in days and one let go cold cracks its lining and is relined at the cost of a rebuild, as a vasectomy reversed within a few years usually restores fertility and reversed after fifteen does so less often, since the unused tract has been scarring shut and the body has been making antibodies against what it no longer releases, as a temporary reporting line that stood a year is the organization and is reversed as a reorganization; the bill is borne by the mover; it is discovered when the quote for the way back comes in, and the quote's size is the date, so a mover who reads it learns how long the move stood; the reversal cannot restore the wet state, only produce a second setting; not lead-time-floors' Gestation, a replacement that must grow, since here it is the move that grew and the growing is the bill.

items.item: Way back rots: the reversal's precondition is held by someone or something outside the move and decays while nobody spends anything, as the old supplier's line is retooled for other customers, the two people who ran the old system leave, the part the old machine needs goes out of production, and the backup that would restore the old state has never been restored from and is found, at the attempt, to be unreadable; the bill is borne by the mover; it is discovered at the attempt, as an absence rather than a price, and it was invisible before because nothing was being paid, so a mover who wants the option must rehearse the reversal while the move stands, a small order to the old supplier, a restore drill, a retainer, and pay the rehearsal as the option's price; the reversal cannot restore the day the way back was still there; not lead-time-floors' Understudy, a spare finished and waiting for the day the source dies, since here the spare is the old source itself, aging while unused, and not pivot-invariants' preservation state from which idle equipment can be recommissioned, which names the asset whose absence this bill is.
items.why: Distinct from Set like plaster, and the author's separating case is right: a restore drill catches rot and does nothing about setting. Adjacent to lead-time-floors' Understudy, whose own text already says the never-restored backup is a fake and the drill is the purchase; this item adds that the decay is by nobody's spending, that the bill is an absence discovered at the attempt, and that rehearsal is the option's price, which is enough to earn the seat.

items.item: Only three shops undo it: the move is a commodity and its reversal is a specialty, so the mover bought from a hundred sellers and must undo through three, who price the reversal against the mover's need and not against their cost, as a tattoo is made by any parlor and removed by a clinic with a laser, as an integration is done by the acquirer's own staff and unpicked by the boutique that does carve-outs, as a system is installed by its vendor and torn out by the one firm that has done it before; the bill is the specialist's margin, borne by the mover; it is discovered at the quote, which comes with the number of other shops that could have given one; the reversal cannot restore the competitive price the move enjoyed, and no rehearsal makes a fourth shop, so the quote is worth getting before the move; not tollgates-that-must-buy, where the gate is compelled to buy from the passers, since here the gate stands only on the way back and sells; and not Way back rots, a capacity that was common and decayed, since this one was never common.
items.why: A specialty reversal of a commodity move is a distinct mechanism from rot, and the operator consequence differs: get the quote before moving, since no rehearsal makes a fourth shop. 'Three' is a figure; the laser-removal market is not that thin, but the asymmetry between the parlors and the clinics is real.

items.item: Writes in the interval: the move opened a period in which new things were made in the move's form, and the reversal has nowhere to put them, as a schema migration is reverted in a minute if nothing has been written and in a week if a month of rows carry a shape the old schema cannot hold, as two merged companies are separated under a transitional services agreement whose whole purpose is to keep paying for the months in which one payroll, one ledger, and one contract book were made, as a rule implemented across an industry is repealed while the filings made under it are still owed; the bill is borne by the mover and by whoever made the writes; it is discovered during the reversal, row by row, when the first thing with no old-form home is found; the reversal cannot restore a state in which the interval's products do not exist, so it must either carry them in a shape they were not made for or delete what people made in good faith; not forms-of-return's Hard reset, the return that deletes the interval and pretends it never happened, since that is the choice this bill prices, and not pivot-invariants' working state that can be restored without reconstructing its history, which names the asset whose absence this is.
items.why: Not a restatement of forms-of-return's Hard reset: Hard reset is a return that deletes the interval, and this item is the bill that makes that deletion a choice with a price, borne partly by people who were not the mover. The transitional services case is a simplification (the agreement pays for shared functions that must be unbundled), but the shape is the same: things made in the merged form with no home in the separated one.

items.item: Route the move revealed: the reversal must travel the way the move came, in front of a party who learned that way by watching the move, as a unit that advanced up a valley withdraws down it under guns that have since registered every bend, as a firm that entered a market through a distributor leaves through the same distributor, who now knows exactly what the firm needs in order to get out; the bill is borne by the mover, in losses on the way back that were not taken on the way out; it is discovered during the reversal, by the adversary first and by the mover second; the reversal cannot restore the route's obscurity, so a mover who expects to reverse goes in by a route it can afford to be seen leaving by, or holds a second route it never used to go in; not Unsayable back, where the counterparty keeps what it learned and prices it later, since here the reversal must be executed inside what was learned; and not first-mover-forecloses, which shuts the rival's options, since here the mover's own move opened its own way back to view.
items.why: A bill incurred during the reversal, in front of a party who learned the route by watching, which no other item carries; the author marks the field case as analytical and I checked that it is not asserted as a named operation. Separates from Unsayable back on whether the reversal must be executed inside what was learned.

items.item: Rebound above baseline: the system the move acted on adapted to the move while it stood, so the reversal lands not on the original state but on the adapted one and overshoots it, as a beta-blocker stopped abruptly produces a heart rate and a pressure above where they were before it was started, as acid suppression withdrawn after months produces more acid than the untreated stomach, as a price cut restored reads to the customer as an increase because the reference price moved to the cut and stayed there, so the seller who takes back a discount faces a demand below the one the discount was given to lift; the bill is borne by the patient, the customer, the firm; it is discovered in the days after the reversal, by whoever is inside the system, and the mover often reads the overshoot as proof the move was needed; the reversal cannot restore the baseline, only reach a new one by a taper, and the taper is the bill's schedule; not risk-rebound-effects' Compensated cushion, where users spend a safety margin on new risk while the protection stands, since here nothing happens until the withdrawal.
items.why: Both medical cases are documented rebound phenomena and the reference-price case is documented in pricing. But 'the reversal cannot restore the baseline' is false for its own first case: a tapered beta-blocker withdrawal returns the patient to the pre-drug baseline. What the reversal cannot do is land on the baseline directly; the taper is the route and its length is the bill. Repaired that clause only.
items.repair: Rebound above baseline: the system the move acted on adapted to the move while it stood, so the reversal lands not on the original state but on the adapted one and overshoots it, as a beta-blocker stopped abruptly produces a heart rate and a pressure above where they were before it was started, as acid suppression withdrawn after months produces more acid than the untreated stomach, as a price cut restored reads to the customer as an increase because the reference price moved to the cut and stayed there, so the seller who takes back a discount faces a demand below the one the discount was given to lift; the bill is borne by the patient, the customer, the firm; it is discovered in the days after the reversal, by whoever is inside the system, and the mover often reads the overshoot as proof the move was needed; the reversal cannot land on the baseline directly, only reach it, or a new one, by a taper, and the taper is the bill's schedule; not risk-rebound-effects' Compensated cushion, where users spend a safety margin on new risk while the protection stands, since here nothing happens until the withdrawal.

items.item: Unsayable back: the move told the counterparty something, an offer, a number, a plan, a defect in diligence, and the reversal keeps the counterparty and leaves it knowing, so the mover lives with a hearer whose knowledge no longer matches any act, as a settlement offer withdrawn stays in the opposing lawyer's head though the evidence rule keeps it out of the trial, as a layoff announced and then cancelled keeps the staff, who now know where they stood on the list, as a code base shown to an acquirer who then walks stays shown; the bill is borne by the mover, in every later dealing with the hearer; it is discovered in the next round, when the counterparty anchors on the withdrawn number or the kept employee gives notice in a better market; the reversal cannot restore ignorance, and, unlike leaving the move standing, it leaves the knowledge unmatched by an act, which the hearer prices as bad faith or as weakness; not deal-deaths' Concession-made option, where a concession reveals a divisibility that kills the deal while it lives, since here the deal lives and the concession is withdrawn.
items.why: Distinct from Route the move revealed (the counterparty keeps what it learned and prices it later, rather than the reversal running inside it) and from deal-deaths' Concession-made option (the deal lives). The observation that withdrawal leaves knowledge 'unmatched by an act', which the hearer prices as bad faith or weakness, is the item's own contribution and survives.

items.item: Retraction read by the room: the reversal itself is a signal the move was not, and third parties who never held a stake in the move update on it, as a recall tells the market the product is defective in a way the launch did not deny, as a tariff withdrawn under one partner's pressure teaches every other partner to press, as a term sheet pulled tells the next founder that the fund pulls, as a rate rise reversed at the next meeting tells the market that the bank does not know; the bill is borne by the mover, in dealings with parties who were not at the table; it is discovered at the next dealing, when the room prices the mover as one that reverses; the reversal cannot restore the room's prior; not walkaway-manufactures' Walk on record, where a record of walks buys credibility, since here a record of un-walks spends it.
items.why: Third parties inferring from the reversal is a distinct bill from a rule forcing the reversal onto a wider channel; my neighbor test below separates the two. Not walkaway-manufactures' Walk on record, as the item says: a record of un-walks spends what a record of walks buys.

items.item: Retraction louder than the claim: the reversal is published on a wider channel than the move was, by a rule that requires the notice and not the act, as a recall must be mailed to every registered owner while the sale was a line in a dealer's book, as hiring fifty people is a line in payroll and letting fifty go is a notice to the state that a reporter reads, as a paper is published in one journal and its retraction is flagged in every index that carries the paper, whether or not a reader of the paper ever sees the flag; the bill is borne by the mover; it is discovered by everyone at once and by the mover last, when the next counterparty mentions what it found in a search; the reversal cannot restore the move's obscurity, so a mover who expects to reverse should make the move on a channel no wider than the one the reversal will be forced onto; not witness-architectures, which asks what must exist for a trace to form, since here two traces form by rule and the asymmetry between them is the bill.
items.why: The rule-forced channel asymmetry is real for the recall and the layoff notice; the journal case is doubtful for the reason the author already gives (retracted papers go on being cited), and the near priority carries the test. The reader who matters here is the one who never saw the move and meets only the retraction, which is what separates this from Retraction read by the room; the item should be read that way and the priority's narrowing, if the journal case fails, would say so.

items.item: Second taxable event: the reversal is a second transaction to a party that was not at the table for the first, and that party bills both legs, as selling a thing to unwind its purchase realizes the gain and pays the duty again, as a house bought and sold within a year pays duty on the way in and tax on the gain on the way out, and in several jurisdictions a surcharge for selling so soon, as a conversion of a retirement account that could once be undone by the following October now cannot, so the unwind is a taxed distribution; the bill is borne by the mover and collected by the treasury; it is discovered at the next filing, by the accountant, months after the reversal has been done and often after the mover has spent the proceeds; the reversal cannot restore the basis, since the asset comes back with a new one; not dilution-carriers, which drain ownership by a route other than price, since here nothing drains and the two legs are simply both charged.
items.why: The mechanism, a party never at the table that bills both legs on its own calendar, is sound, and the stamp-duty and short-hold surcharge cases are real. The Roth conversion case fails the map's own fifth fence: since 2018 the conversion cannot be recharacterized at all, so what the case shows is a way back removed, which the map assigns to option-expiries, and the clause 'the unwind is a taxed distribution' is not accurate, since there is no unwind. Replaced it with the wash-sale rule, a real case where the reversal, buying back within thirty days, cancels the sale's one tax benefit.
items.repair: Second taxable event: the reversal is a second transaction to a party that was not at the table for the first, and that party bills both legs, as selling a thing to unwind its purchase realizes the gain and pays the duty again, as a house bought and sold within a year pays duty on the way in and tax on the gain on the way out, and in several jurisdictions a surcharge for selling so soon, as a stock sold at a loss and bought back within thirty days has the loss refused and folded into the new basis, so the reversal cancels the one tax benefit the move had; the bill is borne by the mover and collected by the treasury; it is discovered at the next filing, by the accountant, months after the reversal has been done and often after the mover has spent the proceeds; the reversal cannot restore the basis, since the asset comes back with a new one; not dilution-carriers, which drain ownership by a route other than price, since here nothing drains and the two legs are simply both charged.

items.item: Hedge left naked: the move was one leg of a pair the mover built, and reversing it leaves the other leg standing as something else, as the loan repaid early leaves the swap that fixed its rate as a bet on rates, as the manager let go leaves the team hired under them as a team with no reason, as the market entered leaves the warehouse leased for it as a warehouse; the bill is borne by the mover, in the other leg's new nature and in its own reversal cost, which is a second bill of this map's kind; it is discovered when the other leg is next priced, by the treasurer who marks the swap or the director who inherits the team; the reversal cannot restore the pair, and the mover must either unwind the other leg, paying its bill, or hold it in its new nature; not risk-rebound-effects' Correlated hedge, where the hedge fails while paired, since here it is unpaired by the mover's own hand, and not Chair already given away, where the reliance is another's, since here the mover relied on itself.
items.why: The early-repaid loan leaving its swap as a rate bet is exact, and the item correctly says the other leg's unwinding is a second bill of this map's kind. Distinct from Chair already given away because the reliance is the mover's own.

items.item: Chair already given away: the counterparty acted on the move in a way it cannot take back, so the reversal restores the mover and not the counterparty, as the candidate who resigned on a signed offer finds the offer withdrawn and the old chair filled, as the carrier that positioned a vessel for a booking finds it cancelled, as the supplier that tooled for a program finds the program dropped; the bill is borne by the counterparty, and the law's answer, reliance damages, moves part of it back into the mover's account and rarely all, since the old chair is not for sale; it is discovered by the counterparty at the rescission and by the mover when the counterparty sues or when the next candidate has heard; the reversal cannot restore the counterparty's prior position; not clean-exits' Queue at the door, where exits are paced so that leaving does not hurt the stayers, since here nothing was paced and the bill lands on the one who moved for the mover.
items.why: Reliance damages as the law's partial answer is right, and 'the old chair is not for sale' is the clause that keeps it a bill the account does not show. Not a restatement of clean-exits' Queue at the door, which paces leavings by terms fixed at entry; here nothing was paced and the bill lands on the party who moved for the mover.

items.item: Strangers built on it: parties the mover never counted built on the move, so the reversal's bill has no denominator, as an interface deprecated finds callers that were never registered, as a bus route cut finds a shift that was chosen for it, as a program of grants ended finds a town of small firms that hired for it; the bill is borne by the strangers, then by the mover when they surface; it is discovered after the reversal, by complaint, in a count the mover could not have made before, and the law's answer, the grandfather clause and the doctrine of legitimate expectation, is to exempt what was built and reverse only for those who have not yet built, which is the bill made explicit and paid in the reversal's incompleteness; the reversal cannot restore the strangers' builds nor the state in which no one had built; not risk-rebound-effects' Levee effect, where protection invites settlement while it stands, since here the settlement is the bill of taking the levee down, and not Chair already given away, whose reliers the mover can name and settle with.
items.why: The unregistered-caller, bus-route, and grant-town cases carry the same mechanism, a bill with no denominator, and the grandfather clause as the bill paid in the reversal's incompleteness is a real observation. Separates from Chair already given away on countability, which is the fork the map claims.

items.item: Successor pays the write-down: the move was made by an office and the reversal is made by a later holder of it, who takes the cost without having had the move's benefit, as the chief executive who acquired has left and the one who divests takes the write-down against their own year, as the government that cut the tax has left office and the one that restores it takes the blame, as the commander who ordered the advance has rotated and the one who withdraws signs for the losses; the bill is borne by the successor, in the record of their tenure; it is discovered on taking office, in the inherited position, and the predecessor never discovers it at all; the reversal cannot restore the credit for the move to the chair that pays for reversing it, so an office whose holders rotate faster than their moves can be undone will make moves and not unmake them, and the reversals wait for a holder with nothing to lose; not clean-exits' Chair filled before it's empty, which conserves continuity for the firm, since here the continuity is what delivers the bill, and not power-trades' Blame-bearer's fee, where the signature is paid to bear the blame, since the successor was never paid.
items.why: As written the item contradicts its own edge. The item says rotating offices make moves and do not unmake them because the successor pays; the edge to Retraction read by the room says the successor pays without the reputation bill because the room reads a successor's reversal as housecleaning. The corporate case decides it: incoming chief executives take the big bath in year one, so reversals cluster at the handover rather than waiting for a holder with nothing to lose. The government and command cases keep the waiting claim because no housecleaning window is granted there. Repaired to name the window as the condition, and added the adjacency to term-sheet-powers' Successor in the chair, which the brief requires since both put a hand that never signed into the chair.
items.repair: Successor pays the write-down: the move was made by an office and the reversal is made by a later holder of it, who takes the cost without having had the move's benefit, as the chief executive who acquired has left and the one who divests takes the write-down against their own year, as the government that cut the tax has left office and the one that restores it takes the blame, as the commander who ordered the advance has rotated and the one who withdraws signs for the losses; the bill is borne by the successor, in the record of their tenure; it is discovered on taking office, in the inherited position, and the predecessor never discovers it at all; the reversal cannot restore the credit for the move to the chair that pays for reversing it; where the room grants a new holder a housecleaning window, the bill is lightest in the successor's first year and reversals cluster at the handover, the incoming chief executive's big bath, and where the room grants none, as with a tax restored or a withdrawal signed, an office whose holders rotate faster than their moves can be undone will make moves and not unmake them, and the reversals wait for a holder with nothing to lose; not clean-exits' Chair filled before it's empty, which conserves continuity for the firm, since here the continuity is what delivers the bill, not term-sheet-powers' Successor in the chair, where the later hand exercises a power it never signed, since here it pays for one, and not power-trades' Blame-bearer's fee, where the signature is paid to bear the blame, since the successor was never paid.

items.item: Truce needed no paper the first time: the state before the move was held up by something never written, a trust, a norm, a habit of not asking, and the move spent it, so the reversal restores the terms and must now hold them with a prop the first state did not need, as a ceasefire broken once is re-signed with monitors, as two firms that did not poach each other's staff and then did can now agree not to only in writing, which in many jurisdictions is a crime, as a couple reconciled after a leaving keeps the marriage with a counselor it did not have; the bill is borne by both parties, in the prop's cost and in the second state's visible dependence on it; it is discovered the second time, when a party notices that the terms are back and the ease is not; the reversal cannot restore the tacitness, since a thing once written cannot be unwritten back into a habit; not forms-of-return's Agamemnon's bath, where the place changed because of the absence, since here what changed is what held the place up, and not cooperation-ignitions, which asks how a first cooperation starts, since here the question is what the second one must be built on.
items.why: A distinct bill: the second state's visible dependence on a prop the first did not need. Not a restatement of forms-of-return's Agamemnon's bath, where the household filled the returner's slot with a plan; here what changed is what held the terms up. The no-poach case is also the map's sharpest instance of a bill that cannot be paid, since the only prop is a crime, and it is what the boundary case's migration can never carry into an entry price.

items.item: Coordination spent: the move was made by many hands at once, on a date set so that everyone changed together, and it consumed a willingness to change together that no single hand holds or can sell, so the reversal has no bill because it has no payer, as Sweden's drivers moved to the right on one Sunday in 1967 and no one has proposed the Sunday for moving back, as an industry that migrated to one standard at one deadline would migrate back only at a second deadline nobody will set; the bill is borne by the group, in the return's unavailability, and by no one's ledger; it is discovered when someone proposes the return and finds no one against it and no one to set the date; the reversal cannot restore the focal moment; the strong form is speculative and fails at Okinawa, which drove on the right under American administration and moved back to the left in 1978 on a date set by a returning sovereign, so the honest claim is that the second coordination needs a date-setter from outside the group, and where none exists the reversal waits forever; the map's other bills are at least presented to someone, so this is the stop where the walk ends, a reversal cheap for every hand and unavailable to all of them; not Truce needed no paper the first time, where what was spent was trust and paper can replace it at a price, since here nothing was spent but the willingness to switch on one date and no paper replaces a date; and not market-births' preconditions, which a market builds or imports, since here the precondition was spent and no one is in the business of resupplying it.
items.why: Out of type as written, by the map's own fifth fence and by the fleet brief's assignment of a lost coordination to option-expiries; and its mechanism, a willingness consumed, is contradicted by the Swedish case, where the switch was imposed against a referendum. What survives is a bill of this map's kind: the move's date was supplied from outside for free and the return's must be manufactured, so the bill is a date-setter's existence, presented to no one until one volunteers. Repaired to say that, keeping the speculative marking, the Okinawa case as the case where the setter existed, and the item's place as the walk's last stop.
items.repair: Coordination spent: the move was made by many hands at once, on a date that something outside the group supplied, a sovereign, a regulator, a deadline, an event, so the reversal's bill is a second such date, which no hand in the group can make for itself and which the move's account never showed because the first date came without being bought, as Sweden's drivers moved to the right on one Sunday in 1967 on a date the Riksdag set against a referendum that had voted to stay left, so the date-setter and not the drivers' willingness did the work, as Okinawa, which drove on the right under American administration, moved back to the left in 1978 on a date a returning sovereign set, and as an industry that migrated to one standard at one deadline would migrate back only at a second deadline nobody is placed to set; the bill is borne by whoever wants the return, in the price of finding or becoming a date-setter, and until one exists it is presented to no one; it is discovered when someone proposes the return and finds no one against it and no one to set the date; the reversal cannot restore the focal moment, only manufacture another; the claim is speculative beyond its cases, and its honest form is that the second coordination needs a date-setter from outside the group, so where none exists the reversal waits, not because the way back is gone but because its bill has no addressee, which is the stop where the walk ends; not Truce needed no paper the first time, where what was spent was trust and paper can replace it at a price, since here what is missing is a date and no paper replaces a date; and not market-births' preconditions, which a market builds or imports, since a group cannot import its own date-setter without becoming subject to one.

neighbor_test.left: Retraction read by the room: the reversal itself is a signal the move was not, and third parties who never held a stake in the move update on it, as a recall tells the market the product is defective in a way the launch did not deny, as a tariff withdrawn under one partner's pressure teaches every other partner to press, as a term sheet pulled tells the next founder that the fund pulls, as a rate rise reversed at the next meeting tells the market that the bank does not know; the bill is borne by the mover, in dealings with parties who were not at the table; it is discovered at the next dealing, when the room prices the mover as one that reverses; the reversal cannot restore the room's prior; not walkaway-manufactures' Walk on record, where a record of walks buys credibility, since here a record of un-walks spends it.
neighbor_test.right: Retraction louder than the claim: the reversal is published on a wider channel than the move was, by a rule that requires the notice and not the act, as a recall must be mailed to every registered owner while the sale was a line in a dealer's book, as hiring fifty people is a line in payroll and letting fifty go is a notice to the state that a reporter reads, as a paper is published in one journal and its retraction is flagged in every index that carries the paper, whether or not a reader of the paper ever sees the flag; the bill is borne by the mover; it is discovered by everyone at once and by the mover last, when the next counterparty mentions what it found in a search; the reversal cannot restore the move's obscurity, so a mover who expects to reverse should make the move on a channel no wider than the one the reversal will be forced onto; not witness-architectures, which asks what must exist for a trace to form, since here two traces form by rule and the asymmetry between them is the bill.
neighbor_test.separating_case: A fund pulls a signed term sheet. No rule publishes the pull; founders hear of it from each other, and the next founder, who also knows the fund signs term sheets, nets the pull against the signing and prices the fund as one that pulls: that is the room reading a reversal it can set beside the move. The same week a carmaker recalls two hundred cars. A rule mails a notice to every registered owner and files it with the regulator, so a fleet buyer who never knew the model existed meets the recall in a search and prices a firm that was recalled, with no move to net it against; the market as a whole, which saw both, barely updates on two hundred units. Hold the room's inference constant and the second bill still falls, because the rule made the trace; hold the rule constant and the first bill still falls, because the room infers from a pull nobody published. They do not collapse: one bill is paid to readers who saw both legs and price the reversal as a habit, the other to readers who saw only the reversal and cannot see a move at all.

boundary_case: The rollback that improves on the way back: the mover, reversing a migration or a reorganization, takes the chance to fix what the original state got wrong, and the reversal's invoice comes in far above a restoration. Tempting because the bill appears at the reversal, is not in the move's account, and is discovered exactly where this map's bills are discovered, by the quote. Ruled out: the excess is a new move's cost hidden inside the reversal's invoice, not a cost of reversing, and the test is whether a pure restoration was ever quoted; an operator who cannot separate the two has bought a third state and called it going back. The ruling sharpens the fence the map already drew against sunk cost: this map bills only what the way back costs, not what the mover spends on the way out or the way back for reasons of its own.

seriation.note: The itinerary holds as an authored walk by when and to whom the bill is presented, and the consequential adjacency the author names, Way back rots to Only three shops undo it, is the right one to teach from, since the two capacities call for opposite operator moves. Two placements deserve a reader's care. Second key for the way back sits in the opening stretch, 'written in a rule before the move', but its unwritten form, the beneficiary who can leave, is not readable before the move, so the item straddles the first two stops and the note should not claim it is wholly readable in advance. With Coordination spent repaired, the walk still ends where the author put it, but the endpoint reads differently: not a bill with no payer, which would be an option expiry, but a bill with no addressee, a date-setter's existence that is presented to no one until someone volunteers to be one; the seriation note's closing clause should say 'because the bill has no addressee' rather than 'no payer'.

edges.why: A real fork with a failing antecedent: whether the reliers can be named is settled before the reversal and decides whether the bill is priced or discovered. The grandfather clause in the target item is the fork's own trace.

edges.to_handle: Second key for the way back
edges.why: The passage holds and its own second clause names the failure: where the relier has only a claim and no say, the bill stays a bill. The European raise case is an observed instance of the law converting a reliance into a consent.

As labeled, rot causes the mover to postpone, but the item says rot is invisible until the attempt because nothing is being paid, so an unattempted mover cannot be postponing because of it. The loop starts only at an attempt where the absence is quoted and the mover balks; routed the label through the attempt and named the case where the loop does not start.
edges.repair_label: If the way back is found rotten at the attempt and the mover will not pay to refill the absence, the move is left standing, and while it stands the move sets, so a reversal balked at rot is quoted later as a demolition; where the mover pays for the absence at once, the loop never starts.

edges.why: Plaster is quoted, so a mover who balks at the demolition is knowingly postponing, and the way back rots further while the move stands; this half of the loop fires as written and the compounding is a real inference the pile did not give.

The conversion is real and its condition, whose hand holds the pen and whether the successor was the mover's deputy, can fail. It was the source item that contradicted the edge, not the edge that was wrong; with the item repaired to name the housecleaning window the two now say the same thing.

edges.from_handle: Second key for the way back
edges.why: The passage is the map's best, but its consequent, 'a capacity nobody can supply', inherits the target item's option-expiry error. With the target repaired, a key held by all hands at once is not unsuppliable; it becomes a date that must bind all hands together, which only a setter outside the group can supply. Relabeled to match.
edges.repair_label: If the second key is held by everyone who made the move together, no holder can sell it and no holder can be bought hand by hand, so a consent that could be priced becomes a date that must bind all hands at once, which only a date-setter outside the group can supply; where one hand holds the key, it is still for sale.

edges.from_handle: Truce needed no paper the first time
edges.to_handle: Second key for the way back
edges.why: As labeled the dependency converts a claim into a key by fiat, which the map's own Chair to Second key edge forbids: a ceasefire with monitors and a marriage with a counselor write remedies and witnesses, not consents, so a third move under them is a breach with a claim against it and no second key. The dependency runs only where the paper writes a term the other party must release. Relabeled as that conditional, with the failing case named.
edges.repair_label: If the second truce's paper writes a term the other party must release, a notice period, a consent to vary, a monitor's sign-off, then that party holds a key over any third move that the first truce's habit did not give it, and a reversal of this kind manufactures the next reversal's bill; where the paper writes only a remedy or a witness, as a monitored ceasefire or a counseled marriage does, a third move is a breach with a claim against it and no key, and the dependency does not run.

modality_problems: Coordination spent asserted 'consumed a willingness to change together' against its own headline case: Sweden's 1955 referendum voted overwhelmingly to keep left and the Riksdag set the 1967 date regardless, so the move was made by a date-setter, not by a willingness; repaired.

Coordination spent's 'the reversal has no bill because it has no payer' and 'unavailable to all of them' describe an option expiry, which the map's own fifth boundary excludes; repaired to a bill with no addressee.

Second taxable event's Roth case: recharacterization of conversions ended for conversions made after 2017, so the way back is gone rather than taxed, and 'the unwind is a taxed distribution' describes a transaction that cannot occur; replaced with the wash-sale rule.
Rebound above baseline's 'cannot restore the baseline' is contradicted by tapered beta-blocker withdrawal, which does; repaired to 'cannot land on the baseline directly'.
Set like plaster names antibodies as the mechanism of falling vasectomy-reversal success; the larger documented mechanism is obstruction of the unused tract; repaired to name both.

Successor pays the write-down's consequence clause, reversals waiting for a holder with nothing to lose, is contradicted in its corporate case by the first-year big bath; repaired to condition on the housecleaning window.
Retraction louder than the claim's journal case is doubtful for the reason the author gives and is properly marked; left standing under its near priority.
Route the move revealed's field case is analytical and is declared so in the mode statement; no repair.

Truce needed no paper the first time's 'in many jurisdictions is a crime' is right for the United States and Canada and is an antitrust offense rather than a crime in most others; a simplification within tolerance, not repaired.
best_unresolved_seed: The boundary case says a bill leaves the map once a counterparty writes it into the entry price, and Only three shops undo it shows a party in the business of selling the way back. Between them sits a map the record points at and does not contain: who sells undo, and what the existence of a seller does to a bill's place on this walk. Recall insurance sells against Retraction louder than the claim, a swap-breakage quote sells against Hedge left naked, a carve-out boutique sells against Only three shops, a restore-drill vendor sells against Way back rots, and a sovereign sells, when it will, the date that Coordination spent needs. The conjecture worth a breath is that every seller moves its bill leftward along the seriation, from discovered-after to quoted-at-the-attempt to priced-at-entry, and that the bills with no possible seller, Unsayable back, the no-poach truce, the stranger who never registered, are the ones that never migrate and so define what the map is about once the market has done its work.
independent_review_line: Fable critic: admitted after repairing six items (recasting Coordination spent from a bill with no payer, an option expiry by the map's own fence, into the bill of a manufactured focal date; reconciling Successor pays the write-down with its own edge by naming the housecleaning window; dropping the repudiated-contract and Roth-recharacterization cases as the move's own paper and a way back removed; correcting the rebound and vasectomy mechanism clauses) and relabeling three edges so the loop starts at the attempt and the two passages hold as conditionals; no item restates clean-exits or forms-of-return.
